'''Chortav Meshurkaane''' was a street on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], located within [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> When translated from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the name Chortav Meshurkaane could be taken to mean either "Gem-Cutters Street" or "Jewelers Street."<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref> The street was home to several [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafs]] and small shops.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

Twice a [[Standard week/Legends|week]], on Keldabe's market [[Standard day/Legends|days]], the numerous tapcafs and stores along Chortav Meshurkaane's length were joined by various temporary market stalls that lined the street. These stalls typically sold items ranging from precious metals and [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]], to [[Leather/Legends|leather]] goods, including [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], [[Belt/Legends|belts]], and [[Kama/Legends|''kamas'']]. One end of Chortav Meshurkaane opened onto a paved, outdoor square in front of the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' tapcaf, a square that also hosted a number of [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] stalls, selling a wide selection of wares and different [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chortav Meshurkaane was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels, written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
